### Understanding Rogue Access Points

A rogue access point is an unauthorized Wi-Fi access point that is set up within a secure network. Attackers use these to capture sensitive information, such as usernames, passwords, and other personal data from users who connect to the rogue network, often believing it to be legitimate.
